title: Onsite Support EUC Engineer
description:
Job Purpose

The EUC onsite support engineer will provide high quality technical support for all End User Computing devices (Laptop, Desktop and mobility) for office-based staff at site, including leading on the resolution of incidents, problems, requests, in order to achieve high standards of customer service and deliver optimum operational and business benefits.

Operation Roles and Responsibilities

❖ Technologies : Microsoft Intune, Zoom Meeting Rooms, Microsoft Office 2010, office 365 products –Windows 10 desktops, laptops, printers, networked copiers, Mobile Iron, NIC's, basic LAN/WAN connectivity, network cable patching, Hands & feet support to Rack and stack activities.

❖ IT Tools – SCCM OS deployment, Intune Autopilot OS deployment, Microsoft MFA, Service NOW Ticketing tool (Incident, Service Requests, Asset management)

  • • Basic experience in IT industry
  • • Good client management & communication skills
  • • Good Understanding of ITIL concept & Service Now
  • • Computer OS/Peripherals troubleshooting. Asset/Inventory Management
  • • Ensure tickets are updated on time and adhere to required SLA.
  • • Handling different PC operating systems (Windows 7, 10)
  • • Handling end users' incidents and IMAC requests using Service NOW ticketing tool
  • • Performing Hardware/Software installation (understanding of deployment tools like SCCM)
  • • End-user support – Break fix & Service Requests
  • • Desktop/ Laptop/Network Printers Management.
  • • Basic AV support for conference room& internal events using MTR (Microsoft Teams Room)
  • • Image Deployment using SCCM & Auto Pilot
  • • VDI technologies Citrix Xendesktop, Azure cloud PC.
  • • Laptop AV/endpoint security Management for Mcafee, Cortex XDR.
  • • User Data Management (OneDrive, Office 365)
  • • Refresh of old asset from windows 7 to windows 10.
  • • MTR Video conference support for meeting room and events.
  • • Vendor coordination for hardware/spare replacement
  • • Incident Management, service Request management, asset Management
  • • Support Queue Management to avoid and SLA misses
  • • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • • Ability to communicate well with internal and external contacts.
  • • Provide strong customer service for internal IT teams as well as Business Partners. Work closely with the Server and Networking teams.
  • • Performing end to end IMAC activity including packaging un-packaging, accepting & delivery of client service assets with proper update of inventory database.
  • • Experience supporting mobile devices; including configuration and troubleshooting of, iPhone, iPad Android devices.
  • • Provide investigation, diagnosis, resolution and recovery for hardware/software problems. When unable to resolve, escalate to vendors in accordance with Help Desk escalation processes.
  • • Maintain overall ownership of user's issue & service ensuring that they receive resolution within a reasonable timeframe.
  • • Responsible for successful deployment and upgrades of laptops & workstations.
  • • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.

title: IT Dispatch Support/Field Support Services
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Position: IT Support Engineer
Working Model: This is a dispatch support / on-need basis position where once there is a ticket raised at the client site, we will inform you at least 24 hours prior for the next on-site visit to troubleshoot and resolve the ticket. The volume of on-site visits is not very heavy so you can take this as a second project too, if you are currently employed and can manage both the positions simultaneously.
Location: Indianapolis, IN
Long term contract
Support will be within business hours and in weekdays (M-F). If anything outside, will be communicated to you.
Compensation: We can pay you in an hourly amount on 1099 for every time you are called to work on-site.
NOTE: The engineer should have their own laptop to carry while being on-site so you can be connected remotely via support team for instructions/guidelines.

  • Experience providing IT Infrastructure field support which includes troubleshooting hardware, software, operating system issues and problems and fixing the issues without impacting / violating the hardware warranty.
Hands on experience with ServiceNow.
  • Hands on experience in installing, troubleshooting and fixing desktops, printers, laptop and other computer peripherals hardware problems as well as desktop applications.
  • Basic knowledge of enterprise LAN and WAN setups and concepts. Ability to perform smart hand activity under instruction based activities at sites.
  • Ability to lift / move computer equipment weighing up to 50Lbs.
  • Skilled in desk side support and PC break/fix including basic administration of Windows O/S.

Job Types: Part-time, Contract

Schedule:
Monday to Friday
On call

title: Sage Developer
description:

Location: 100% Remote (Candidate can work from anywhere in LATAM or India)

Job Description:

  • Required Technical Skills: Need experience with Sage 300, EDI (Electronic data interchange), NET 9 (using Maui), and SQL. Need to be mid to senior-level experience (6+ years of experience) and be able to work on both inventory management and EDI project

title: Technical Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Job Title: Technical Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Partner
Job Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)
Employment Type: Contract-to-Hire
Work Location: 100% Remote (Canada-based applicants only)
Working Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM or 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST

Company Overview

SkySys, headquartered in North Carolina, USA, is a technology staffing and consulting firm supporting clients across the US, Canada, LATAM, and India. We specialize in delivering top-tier IT and Engineering talent and solutions. We are looking for a passionate and experienced Technical Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Partner to join our remote team. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a collaborative team and help shape recruitment strategies that drive value for our clients.

Position Summary

We are seeking a motivated and experienced recruiter with a background in IT and Engineering staffing. The ideal candidate will be skilled in sourcing and engaging top talent while also contributing to client relationship management and business development efforts.

Key Responsibilities

Recruiting & Sourcing

  • Source and engage qualified candidates using tools such as LinkedIn, Dice, Monster, CareerBuilder, Indeed, and ZipRecruiter.

  • Conduct initial screening interviews to assess skills, experience, and cultural fit.

  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle—from sourcing to offer negotiation and onboarding.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with candidates, ensuring a positive experience throughout the hiring process.

  • Stay current with industry and market trends to identify emerging talent pools.

  • Maintain accurate candidate data in ATS and recruitment trackers.

Sales & Account Management

  • Assist in managing and nurturing client relationships.

  • Collaborate with leadership on client engagement and delivery strategies.

  • Contribute to business development efforts through talent market insights and lead generation.

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of full-cycle recruitment experience, ideally in an agency environment.

  • Proven success in hiring for both contract and full-time (direct hire) roles.

  • Experience with B2B client interaction or account management is a plus.

  • Familiarity with various North American employment classifications (e.g., W2, Corp-to-Corp, 1099, T4, T4A, Open Work Permits, etc.).

  • Knowledge of international hiring practices (India, LATAM) is a plus.

  • Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

  • Self-starter with a goal-driven mindset and minimal need for supervision.

Why Join SkySys?

  • Be part of a remote-first company culture focused on growth and collaboration.

  • Work alongside a leadership team that values innovation and accountability.

  • Opportunity to gain international recruiting experience across multiple markets.

  • Competitive compensation and potential path to permanent employment.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Role: Quality Assurance Engineer
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: Long Term (with a Possssibility-of-Conversion)
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Location: Hybrid (2x days onsite) in Bangalore,India - upon conversion

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Quality Assurance Engineer with strong automation and manual testing skills to join our growing QA team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Playwright or similar automation frameworks, REST API testing, and will be responsible for ensuring high-quality releases through robust test planning, execution, and reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright or equivalent frameworks (e.g., Cypress, Selenium, Puppeteer).
  • Perform manual testing for new features, bug fixes, and regression cycles.
  • Conduct REST API testing using tools such as Postman, Newman, or similar.
  • Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test reports to ensure complete coverage.
  • Collaborate with developers, product managers, and DevOps teams to identify and resolve defects early.
  • Participate in code reviews, contribute to QA strategy, and promote best testing practices.
  • Support CI/CD integration of automated tests and continuous improvement of test pipelines.
  • Ensure test documentation is up to date and aligned with project requirements.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software testing (automation and manual).
  • Strong hands-on experience with Playwright or similar automation tools (Cypress, Selenium, Puppeteer).
  • Proficiency in REST API testing (Postman, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of test design techniques, SDLC, and Agile methodologies.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git).
  • Familiarity with AWS infrastructure.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and documentation abilities.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with performance and load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6).
  • Knowledge of scripting languages like C#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python.
  • Exposure to containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.

title: Senior Analytics Support Engineer
description:
Role: Senior Analytics Support Engineer
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: Long Term (with a Possssibility-of-Conversion)
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Location: Hybrid (2x days onsite) in Bangalore,India - upon conversion

About the Role:
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Analytics Support Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on expertise in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Looker, and Tableau, along with solid technical knowledge in Python, SQL, and AWS infrastructure.
You will play a critical role in managing analytics implementations, data pipelines, and reporting solutions to empower business decisions with accurate, actionable insights.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain tracking solutions using GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Develop, manage, and optimize data visualizations and dashboards in Looker and Tableau.
  • Write efficient SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and validation.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot data issues and ensure data accuracy and integrity.
  • Build and maintain Python scripts for data automation, analysis, and reporting.
  • Support data pipelines and ETL processes in AWS environments (e.g., S3, Lambda, Redshift).
  • Monitor analytics configurations, tag deployments, and conversion tracking to ensure reliable data flow.
  • Provide documentation, training, and support to stakeholders on analytics tools and reporting platforms.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in analytics or data engineering/support roles.
  • Proven experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM).
  • Strong command of Looker and/or Tableau for building advanced dashboards and visualizations.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL for data manipulation and automation.
  • Experience working within AWS infrastructure (e.g., S3, EC2, Lambda, Redshift).
  • Deep understanding of data governance, tracking architecture, and web analytics best practices.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with BigQuery, Redshift, or other cloud data warehouses.
  • Experience integrating marketing and product analytics tools.
  • Understanding of APIs and data ingestion frameworks.

  • Propose KPIs and design interactive dashboards that meet client needs

Job description :
Business Intelligence Analyst
Join a dynamic team where the main objective of each project is to create added value by optimizing our tools and conducting advanced analyses whose insights have a real impact on business management.
The Business Intelligence Analyst is a full-time position within the Project Management Office (PMO) team. The primary responsibilities of this role include contributing to the implementation of reports, dashboards, and performance indicators that support strategic decision-making.

==
Le candidat doit posséder les qualifications suivantes :

Tâches principales :
  • Collecter, analyser et documenter les exigences d'affaires liées au développement de tableaux de bord et de rapports Power BI
  • Proposer des indicateurs de performance (KPI) et concevoir des tableaux de bord interactifs répondant aux besoins des clients
  • Présenter les tableaux de bord aux différentes parties prenantes
  • Émettre des recommandations pour le développement de solutions techniques
  • Préparer la documentation liée à l'utilisation des tableaux de bord développés
  • Assurer le bon fonctionnement de l'environnement Power BI
  • Coordonner le lancement de nouveaux tableaux de bord (développement, tests)

Exigences :
  • Expérience dans des entreprises de plus de 10 000 employés
  • 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en tant qu'analyste en intelligence d'affaires ou dans un poste similaire
  • Connaissances techniques de Power BI
  • Capacité à collecter, analyser et documenter les exigences d'affaires liées au développement de tableaux de bord et rapports Power BI
  • Capacité à proposer des KPI et à concevoir des tableaux de bord interactifs adaptés aux besoins des clients
  • Capacité à présenter les tableaux de bord aux différentes parties prenantes
  • Bilingue (français et anglais)

Atouts :
  • Connaissance de ServiceNow (un atout)
  • Expérience dans des entreprises des secteurs manufacturier, transport, automobile ou aéronautique
  • Expérience au sein d'entreprises internationales ayant des activités sur plusieurs continents

Description de poste :

Analyste en intelligence d'affaires
Faites partie d'une équipe dynamique où chaque projet a pour objectif principal de créer de la valeur ajoutée en optimisant nos outils et en réalisant des analyses avancées dont les résultats ont un réel impact sur la gestion de l'entreprise.
Le poste d'analyste en intelligence d'affaires est un emploi à temps plein au sein de l'équipe du Bureau de projets (PMO). Les principales responsabilités consistent à contribuer à la mise en œuvre de rapports, de tableaux de bord et d'indicateurs de performance afin de soutenir la prise de décisions stratégiques.

title: Spécialiste en gestion des données d’entreprise
description:
Title : Enterprise Data Management Specialist / Spécialiste en gestion des données d'entreprise
Location / Lieu: 100% remote, occasional travel to any office / 100 % télétravail, déplacements occasionnels peu importe le bureau
Duration / Durée : January 31, 2026 + renewal / 31 janvier 2026 + renouvellement

The candidate must have the following qualifications:
Requirements:
  • Expertise in companies with more than 10,000 employees
  • Senior expertise in Enterprise-level Data Management strategy and operations
  • Demonstrated ability to establish a Data Management framework, structure its processes, and communicate its service offerings
  • Clear experience in Master Data Management and related services, both in operations and project contexts
  • Familiarity not only with Agile methodology but also experience in redesigning delivery models and processes to be leaner and more agile
  • Strong understanding of effective Data Migration and Conversion methodologies
  • Leading employees through personal growth, development, and change
  • 10+ years of total work experience in data migration, master data management, and/or data governance roles; experience leading data migration and conversion projects
  • 5+ years of experience working in complex data ecosystems with SAP or a similar ERP
  • 5+ years of experience in people management
  • Demonstrated experience with a Data Migration/Conversion platform (e.g., Syniti ADM)
  • Familiarity with SQL and Collibra
  • Familiarity with Informatica or similar Data Quality tools
  • Language: Bilingual preferred

Assets:
  • Experience with data governance and platform development are assets
  • Expertise in companies within the manufacturing, transportation, automotive, and aerospace sectors
  • Companies operating internationally, with activities on multiple continents
  • Multi-site companies
YOUR ROLE
In your role you will manage a dedicated team of Data Management Analysts and Engineers that are responsible for a range of functions and capabilities, such as: master data management, reference data management, data incident investigations, data quality reporting and scorecarding, data migration and conversions, establishing data object communities of practice, records (data lifecycle) management and more.
This is a leadership role where you will be expected to understand the day to day of the data management roles and functions and provide strategic direction, for operations as well as for the project/initiative engagements.

YOUR SKILLS
  • Senior expertise in Enterprise-level Data Management strategy and operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to form a Data Management framework, structure its processes and communicate its service offerings.
  • Clear experience in Master Data Management and related services, in operations and project contexts.
  • Familiarity not just of Agile methodology but experience in redesigning delivery models and processes to be more lean and agile.
  • Strong understanding of effective Data Migration and Conversion methodology.
  • Leading employees through personal growth, development, and change.
  • Building relationships with cross-functional colleagues to develop knowledge and awareness as a way of improving data management capabilities and team relations.
  • Deploying organizational change management techniques to smoothly introduce change into your operational team and within the broader business (e.g. new templates, tools, processes).
  • Employing strategies to support the business data owners and stewards relative to their data maturity level and enabling them to progress on their tailored roadmaps.
  • Implementing methods, tools and processes to ensure the highest data quality, understanding the impact that data quality has on cross-functional business units.
  • Overseeing the generation of master data standard operating procedures, data object and element policies and the measurement of them.
  • Clearly communicating in written and verbal communications.

===

Le candidat doit posséder les qualifications suivantes :

Exigences :
  • Expertise dans des entreprises de plus de 10 000 employés
  • Expertise senior en stratégie et opérations de gestion des données au niveau entreprise
  • Capacité démontrée à établir un cadre de gestion des données, structurer ses processus et communiquer ses offres de services
  • Expérience claire en gestion des données de référence (Master Data Management) et services connexes, tant en opérations qu'en contexte de projets
  • Familiarité non seulement avec la méthodologie Agile, mais aussi expérience dans la refonte des modèles et processus de livraison pour les rendre plus agiles et allégés
  • Bonne compréhension des méthodologies efficaces de migration et conversion de données
  • Expérience en accompagnement des employés dans leur croissance personnelle, développement et gestion du changement
  • Plus de 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle totale en migration de données, gestion des données de référence et/ou gouvernance des données ; expérience dans la gestion de projets de migration et conversion de données
  • Plus de 5 ans d'expérience dans des écosystèmes de données complexes utilisant SAP ou un ERP similaire
  • Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en gestion d'équipes
  • Expérience démontrée avec une plateforme de migration/conversion de données (ex : Syniti ADM)
  • Familiarité avec SQL et Collibra
  • Familiarité avec Informatica ou des outils similaires de qualité des données
  • Langue : bilingue préféré

Atouts :
  • Expérience en gouvernance des données et développement de plateformes sont des atouts
  • Expertise dans des entreprises des secteurs manufacturier, transport, automobile et aéronautique
  • Entreprises opérant à l'international, avec des activités sur plusieurs continents
  • Entreprises multisites

VOTRE RÔLE
Dans votre rôle, vous gérerez une équipe dédiée d'analystes et d'ingénieurs en gestion des données responsables de diverses fonctions et capacités telles que : la gestion des données de référence, la gestion des données de référence, les investigations d'incidents de données, le reporting et scorecarding de la qualité des données, la migration et conversion de données, la mise en place de communautés de pratique sur les objets de données, la gestion du cycle de vie des données (records management), et plus encore.
Il s'agit d'un rôle de leadership où l'on attend de vous que vous compreniez le quotidien des rôles et fonctions en gestion des données, tout en fournissant une direction stratégique tant pour les opérations que pour les projets et initiatives.

VOS COMPÉTENCES
  • Expertise senior en stratégie et opérations de gestion des données au niveau entreprise
  • Capacité démontrée à créer un cadre de gestion des données, structurer ses processus et communiquer ses offres de services
  • Expérience claire en gestion des données de référence et services associés, en opérations et en contexte de projets
  • Familiarité non seulement avec la méthodologie Agile, mais aussi expérience dans la refonte des modèles et processus de livraison pour les rendre plus agiles et allégés
  • Bonne compréhension des méthodologies efficaces de migration et conversion de données
  • Accompagnement des employés dans leur croissance personnelle, développement et gestion du changement
  • Création de relations avec des collègues interfonctionnels afin de développer connaissances et sensibilisation pour améliorer les capacités de gestion des données et les relations d'équipe
  • Mise en œuvre de techniques de gestion du changement organisationnel pour introduire en douceur des changements dans votre équipe opérationnelle et au sein de l'entreprise (ex : nouveaux modèles, outils, processus)
  • Mise en place de stratégies pour soutenir les propriétaires et responsables des données en fonction de leur niveau de maturité des données, et les aider à progresser sur leurs feuilles de route personnalisées
